verdict.rationale: Much of the operational surface is exposed programmatically. Catalog publishing goes through the v2 Product Catalog Import API with webhooks, and agent orders arrive as `checkout.session.completed` events that can be bulk-fulfilled via List CheckoutSessions. SPT create, limit and revoke calls, embedded checkout and machine payments are all API-driven, and a hosted MCP server and Link CLI add agent-facing access. However, seller onboarding and per-agent consent are described as Dashboard self-serve steps. Agent attribution filtering is shown in the Dashboard, while the API field `agent_details` is only in private preview. MCP write actions such as refunds require a human to click Approve on a URL. Missing for 10: an API path for seller onboarding and agent selection/consent, GA API parity for agent attribution (agent_details is preview-only), any explicit API/UI parity claim, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
